# Badge (`badge`)

Small label or count: default, beta, success, warning, error.

Group: Feedback. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/feedback';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createBadge` (types in `dist/web/feedback/badge.d.ts`): `.mh-badge--<tone>`: a small label, count or dot (`--dot`, `role="img"` named by its label).

```ts
export function createBadge(options: BadgeOptions = {}): BadgeHandle;

export interface BadgeOptions {
  /** Text label ("Beta", "New"). For a dot, its accessible name. */
  label?: string;
  /** A count; shown as `max+` above `max`. Ignored when `label` is set. */
  count?: number;
  max?: number;
  /** Default: `danger` for counts and dots, `neutral` for labels. */
  tone?: BadgeTone;
  /** A small dot with no text. */
  dot?: boolean;
  /** Pinned to the top end corner of a `.mh-badge-host` parent (icon buttons, avatars). */
  attached?: boolean;
  /** Accessible text when the visible text alone isn't enough ("3 unread"). */
  ariaLabel?: string;
}

export interface BadgeHandle {
  el: HTMLSpanElement;
  /** Updates the count; zero hides the badge. */
  setCount(count: number): void;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
}
```

`createIconButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/iconButton.d.ts`): `.mh-icon-button`: a round, icon-only button at least a touch target wide.

```ts
export function createIconButton(options: IconButtonOptions): IconButtonHandle;

export interface IconButtonOptions {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the button's accessible name (also its tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  /** A filled circle (raised surface) rather than a bare glyph. */
  filled?: boolean;
  /** Toggle buttons: sets `aria-pressed`. */
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface IconButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setIcon(icon: IconName | string): void;
  setPressed(pressed: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createBadge, createIconButton, h } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const badge = createBadge({ count: 4, attached: true, ariaLabel: '4 unread' });

const bell = createIconButton({
  icon: 'bell',
  label: 'Notifications',
  filled: true,
  // Opening them marks them read; a count of zero hides the badge.
  onClick: () => badge.setCount(0),
});

// The host pins the badge to the button's top end corner.
document.body.append(h('span', { class: 'mh-badge-host' }, bell.el, badge.el));
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Badge, IconButton } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function BadgeExample() {
  const [unread, setUnread] = useState(4);
  return (
    // The host pins the badge to the button's top end corner.
    <span className="mh-badge-host">
      {/* Opening them marks them read; a count of zero hides the badge. */}
      <IconButton icon="bell" label="Notifications" filled onClick={() => setUnread(0)} />
      <Badge count={unread} attached ariaLabel={`${unread} unread`} />
    </span>
  );
}
```
